description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_face_flux_laplacian_lev: the compound D(K*D(u,lev) - F, lev) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior total-flux difference stencil aggregate over [2,7]; face closures at k=1 and k=8 whose domain-face flux is the prescribed -F[1] / -F[9] alone, no free names; every interior flux the one interface_total_flux_lev template over interface_flux_K_lev). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST in the esm-spec 9.6.4 reference-preserving form (the rule body's stencil references, the grid geometry templates the observeds zc and dz apply to the 9-interface array ze, and the shared mesh/mms_column.esm test-column templates all survive uninlined in the document's template registry), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, the free-name geometry arrays surviving as index references and the lev_nodes axis folded to size 9. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
